title.narrative: Malaria - Africa - Multicountry Southern Africa E8 (01-Apr-2019-30-Sep-2021)

description.narrative: Multicountry Southern Africa E8, Malaria, SADC Malaria Elimination Eight Secretariat (E8 Secretariat)This program has the following goals: To enable and accelerate zero local transmission in the four frontline countries by 2020 through the provision of a platform for collaboration and joint strategic programming. The objectives of this program are: To strengthen regional coordination in order to achieve elimination in each of the E8 member countries. To elevate and maintain the regional elimination agenda at the highest political levels within the E8 countries. To promote knowledge management, quality control, and policy harmonization to accelerate progress towards elimination. To facilitate the reduction of cross-border malaria transmission. To secure resources to support the regional elimination plan, and to ensure long term sustainable financing for the region’s elimination ambitions

title.narrative: Impact indicators targets and results for QPA-M-E8SP02
Malaria I-Other 1: Confirmed local malaria cases (microscopy or RDT) per 1,000 persons per year along the border districts (frontline).
Malaria I-Other 3: Inpatient malaria deaths per 100,000 persons per year along the border districts, frontline countries.
Malaria I-Other 4: Inpatient malaria deaths per 100,000 persons per year, along the border districts, second line countries.
Malaria I-Other 2: Confirmed total malaria cases (microscopy or RDT) per 1,000 persons per year along the border districts (second line).
Outcome indicators targets and results for QPA-M-E8SP02
Proportion of households sprayed by IRS within the last 12 months
Coverage / Output indicators targets and results for QPA-M-E8SP02
Percentage of confirmed cases fully investigated and classified
Proportion of health facilities without stock-outs of key commodities during the reporting period
Number of long-lasting insecticidal nets distributed to targeted risk groups through continuous distribution
Proportion of suspected malaria cases that receive a parasitological test at public sector health facilities
Proportion of malaria cases (presumed and confirmed) that received first line antimalarial treatment at public sector health facilities
Percentage of HMIS or other routine reporting units submitting timely reports according to national guidelines
Proportion of households in targeted areas that received Indoor Residual Spraying during the reporting period
